title: Highly stable and differentially arranged hexanuclear lanthanide clusters: structure, assembly mechanism, and magnetic resonance imaging

material_class.structural_family: hexanuclear {Dy6O} cluster with face-to-face, dislocated Dy3(L1) template motifs

synthesis.procedure: Dy(OAc)3·4H2O (0.4 mmol) and H2L1 (0.05 mmol; N'2,N'6-bis(4-(diethylamino)-2-hydroxybenzylidene)pyridine-2,6-dicarbohydrazide) were dissolved in MeOH/H2O (1.0 mL : 0.3 mL), 100 μL triethylamine was added, and the mixture was reacted under solvothermal conditions at 80 °C for 48 h to give orange blocky crystals of Dy6.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Orange blocky crystals of Dy6 were obtained directly from the solvothermal reaction.

properties.summary: χMT at 300 K is 83.65 cm3 K mol−1, slightly below the six-Dy(III) theoretical value 85.02 cm3 K mol−1, and falls to 68.15 cm3 K mol−1 at 2 K. Magnetization at 2 K saturates incompletely (maximum 75.98 Nβ); M vs H/T curves do not overlay. Hysteresis is not obvious at 2 K, and no clear frequency-dependent χ″ is observed under zero DC field, consistent with crystal-field effects and quantum tunneling rather than SMM behavior.

material_class.structural_family: hexanuclear {Dy6O} cluster with inverted coplanar Dy3(L2) template motifs

synthesis.procedure: The same solvothermal protocol as Dy6 (0.4 mmol Dy(OAc)3·4H2O, 0.05 mmol ligand, 100 μL triethylamine, 80 °C, 48 h) was used with H2L2 (N'2,N'6-bis((2-hydroxynaphthalen-1-yl)methylene)pyridine-2,6-dicarbohydrazide) in place of H2L1, and the solvent was changed to 2.0 mL anhydrous methanol, affording yellow blocky crystals of HNP-Dy6.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Yellow blocky crystals of HNP-Dy6 were obtained from the methanol solvothermal reaction.

properties.summary: χMT at 300 K is 82.13 cm3 K mol−1 versus a six-Dy(III) theoretical 85.02 cm3 K mol−1; upon cooling it first stays near 82.13 cm3 K mol−1 at 100 K then drops to 63.18 cm3 K mol−1 at 2 K. Magnetization at 2 K reaches 36.90 Nβ at 13 kOe and M vs H/T curves do not overlay. Hysteresis is not obvious at 2 K and χ″ shows no clear frequency dependence under zero DC field.

synthesis.procedure: Gd6 was obtained as the homologue of Dy6 under the same solvothermal conditions used for Dy6 (0.4 mmol metal acetate, 0.05 mmol H2L1, MeOH/H2O 1.0 mL : 0.3 mL, 100 μL triethylamine, 80 °C, 48 h) after replacing Dy(OAc)3·4H2O with Gd(OAc)3·H2O.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Prepared under the same conditions as Dy6; crystals of Gd6 were used for MRI/MCE studies.

properties.summary: Gd6 is a potential T1-weighted MRI contrast agent: r1 = 12.06 mM−1 s−1 and r2 = 24.10 mM−1 s−1 at 1 T (r2/r1 = 1.99), higher than clinical Gd-DTPA under the same field, with concentration-dependent T1 brightening. Magnetocaloric −ΔSm(max) = 25.76 J kg−1 K−1 at 2 K and ΔH = 7 T (theoretical 40.06 J kg−1 K−1), attributed to antiferromagnetic Gd···Gd coupling. UV–vis absorbance at 422 nm of Gd6 in H2O/PBS is essentially unchanged over 1–7 days, indicating solution stability.

measurements.name: UV–vis absorbance (stability)
measurements.value: no significant change at 422 nm over 1–7 days
measurements.conditions: Gd6 crystals dissolved in DMSO and dispersed in H2O or PBS
